According to folk tradition, frankincense carries the highest vibration of male energies; sandalwood is believed to attract women in Indian culture; and the fiery, strengthening ginger may awaken your masculine energy as well as functions as an aphrodisiac. It is recommended in cases of physical or mental block and stagnant internal processes connected to masculinity (Yang energy) or the male genitalia. It may boost self-confidence, provide emotional stability and support healthy function of the genitalia.

Ritual · how to use

A) In case of infection, weakness, stagnation, pain or irregularity of the genitalia / urinary tract, contact your physician. You can support the natural flow of your life energy during your medical treatment (approved by your physician) with the blend as following; apply 3-5 drops on your lower abdomen, in case of skin sensitivity, together with a small amount of base oil (cold pressed sesame, sunflower seed or apricot seed oil) and massage it into the area. Apply mornings & evenings for 3 weeks and than keep 1 week break and repeat the treatment if necessary. Always inhale the rest of the scent from your palms 5 times deeply and rhythmically.

B) In case of weakness or stagnation resulting from psychic, emotional or stress related shock or in case of lack of self-confidence add 8-10 drops into your diffuser for the night + mornings apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent 7 times deeply and rhythmically + apply 3 drops on your Solar plexus (energy centre above the belly button) for 21 days and keep 1 week of break. Repeat the pocess if necessary.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Ammi visnaga (toothpick weed), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Boswellia carterii (frankincense), Santalum album (sandalwood), Piper nigrum (black pepper) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Psychological stress can also affect all areas of our health, including our libido, achieving an erection or reaching an orgasm. Exercise is a great way to reduce stress and improve our health. Talking to our partner about our stress can also calm us down, while strengthening our relationship at the same time.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours.
